summary: This bill makes the qualified business income deduction under Section 199A of the Internal Revenue Code permanent by repealing its expiration after 2025.

scores.thoughts: The bill amends the tax code to make permanent a deduction for qualified business income. It contains no provisions related to government expenditures, appropriations, or spending levels of any kind.

The bill's sole purpose is to strike the sunset provision in IRC Section 199A, making the 20% qualified business income deduction permanent for tax years after 2025. This directly lowers taxes for pass-through businesses and is the central focus of the legislation.
No provisions address healthcare policy, insurance, providers, or coverage models.

The bill reduces future tax revenue by making a deduction permanent but contains no language about deficits, debt reduction, or fiscal offsets. Any debt impact is indirect and secondary.
